ValidationRule.description: Validates that the Personal ID Number follows PESEL format and checksum rules.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
OR( NOT( REGEX( Personal_ID_Number__c, "^[0-9]{11}$" ) ),
MOD( 10 - MOD( VALUE(MID(Personal_ID_Number__c,1,1))*1 + VALUE(MID(Personal_ID_Number__c,2,1))*3 + VALUE(MID(Personal_ID_Number__c,3,1))*7 + VALUE(MID(Personal_ID_Number__c,4,1))*9 + VALUE(MID(Personal_ID_Number__c,5,1))*1 + VALUE(MID(Personal_ID_Number__c,6,1))*3 + VALUE(MID(Personal_ID_Number__c,7,1))*7 + VALUE(MID(Personal_ID_Number__c,8,1))*9 + VALUE(MID(Personal_ID_Number__c,9,1))*1 + VALUE(MID(Personal_ID_Number__c,10,1))*3, 10 ), 10 ) <> VALUE(RIGHT(Personal_ID_Number__c,1)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter a valid PESEL number (11 digits with a correct checksum).
